# Design evaluation: candidate

## Identity and provenance

- Work/brief/RQ references:
- Candidate ID and exact revision or artifact digest:
- Rubric ID/version:
- Reviewer/session and actual model/harness when applicable:
- Review mode: independent-session / human / self-review
- Independence limitations and prior generator context received:
- Actual tools used and candidate access:
- Observed states, viewports and fixture data:
- Evidence class: actual observation / supplied capture / synthetic example
- Evidence references and digests or immutable artifact references:
- Budget used/remaining and observed usage limits:

An evaluator receives the brief, rubric, candidate and access instructions.
Generator self-ratings are claims, not evidence. Inspect the candidate when access
exists; distinguish your observations from supplied captures. No browser access
means interaction checks remain unverified. A fresh session or human can evaluate
later; do not label the same generator session independent.

## Verdict and continuation

- Contract verdict: accepted / needs-work / unverified
- Required failures, missing observations or below-threshold ratings:
- Stop/continue reason and remaining authorized budget:
- Prior candidate comparison under the same rubric:
- Next evaluator/generator action and access prerequisite:

Use needs-work for a known required failure or insufficient required rating.
Use unverified when required evidence is missing without a known failure. A static
candidate can receive supported visual ratings while interactions stay unverified.
Acceptance here concerns this reviewed design contract only; it is not human
preference, live qualification, implementation completion or `work finish`.
